description: Ordered image recipe of deployment/image/build_image.py: Radxa OS r2 _4096 + the deploy.py controller bundle -> A/B UFS image file. Every list cites its source; build_image.py records what it applied and what was absent in image-manifest.json.

kernel_debs_install.source: build/07-pz-vstanovlennia.md:68-69 (dpkg -i of the image/headers debs and their two metapackages before any apt run); linux-libc-dev-radxa-dragon-q6a stays in the cache only: it depends on linux-libc-dev-6.18.2-4-qcom, which the lock does not carry (CI image build 2026-10-24)

mask.source: build/07-pz-vstanovlennia.md:92-96; STACK.md:845 (sleep targets); rsetup.service runs `rsetup __on_boot`, which executes /config/before.txt (https://github.com/radxa-pkg/rsetup debian/rsetup.service, read 2026-10-24) - STACK.md:138 never rsetup in the field, STACK.md:843 BLS entries never from rsetup; ssh.service, ssh.socket, smbd.service, nmbd.service: before.txt disable_service ssh ssh.socket smbd nmbd systemd-networkd (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/radxa-pkg/rsetup/main/config/before.txt, read 2026-11-06), which this image does not run (systemd-networkd is not enabled in r2: image-facts.json units); samba-ad-dc.service (enabled in r2, the samba set), cups.service, cups.socket, cups.path, avahi-daemon.service, avahi-daemon.socket: r2 enables them (image-facts.json multi-user.target.wants, sockets.target.wants), the SR-RX controller needs no print, file-sharing or mDNS service, and avahi announces the unit on any connected LAN; IMG-06 may unmask a service with a recorded reason. IMG-06 decision (build/15-rishennia-komplektu.md «Збирання образу», 07.11.2026): bluetooth.service and wpa_supplicant.service (enabled in r2: image-facts.json bluetooth.target.wants, multi-user.target.wants of CI run 42300813861) are masked, also by deploy.py stage (deployment/system/system_files.py MASKED_UNITS): the field/QUIET root is receive-only, the AIC8800 drivers are blacklisted on it, and wpa_supplicant is the component that would start Wi-Fi frames if an interface ever appeared; ubuntu-advantage.service, ua-reboot-cmds.service, ua-timer.timer and motd-news.timer (enabled in r2, same facts) contact Canonical services, and STACK.md:894 makes the signed offline repository the only package source; NetworkManager stays enabled for wired bench Ethernet (the staged polkit NO rule blocks Wi-Fi enable, scan and hotspot); W2 IMG-2 decision (build/15 «Сеанс до greetd (W2 IMG-2)»): gdm.service and gdm3.service of r2's gdm3 46.2-1ubuntu1~24.04.6 (image-facts.json packages_of_interest and interesting_units of CI run 42390143862) are masked, so graphical.target starts no GNOME greeter (gdm3's postinst links display-manager.service to its unit; the builder refuses a display-manager link to an unmasked unit): the field image has no GNOME session (STACK.md:160: greetd and labwc, W2 IMG-4)

rsetup_first_boot.source: rsetup config/before.txt on the main branch (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/radxa-pkg/rsetup/main/config/before.txt, read 2026-11-06): no_fail, log, update_generic_hostname, add_user + user_append_group (radxa, rock), resize_root, disable_service ssh ssh.socket smbd nmbd systemd-networkd, regenerate_ssh_hostkey, update_locale, `if headless enable_service ssh`, rebuild_current_overlays, remove_packages rsetup-config-first-boot. The r2 copy (/config/before.txt, sha256 and command list in image-facts.json rsetup_first_boot) is what the builder checks: a command without a row here is a blocker, and so is a disable_service unit that is neither masked nor disabled in the image

handled.no_fail: no effect: error mode of the script
handled.update_generic_hostname: skipped: the golden image keeps the r2 hostname (image-facts.json root.hostname, radxa-dragon-q6a in CI run 42300813861); IMG-06 decision: one golden image serves many units, so commissioning sets the per-unit hostname from the acceptance hardware_unit_id (format: build/15 «Ім'я хоста (W2 SYS-HOST)», written by srrx.provision prepare)
handled.add_user: skipped: no radxa/radxa or rock/rock accounts; any account with a usable password is locked (lock_default_password_accounts); IMG-06 decision: no password account in the image; operator access is the local HMI, service access the rescue microSD and the UART5 console of the service hatch (boot messages; no account can log in) (build/15)
handled.resize_root: skipped: root A and B have fixed sizes; recovery_kit.py write grows /data to the UFS end
handled.disable_service: replaced: every named unit is masked here (mask.units) or not enabled in the image (checked by the builder)
handled.regenerate_ssh_hostkey: replaced: the builder removes r2's /etc/ssh/ssh_host_* (names in image-manifest.json hardening); srrx-ssh-hostkeys.service runs ssh-keygen -A before the first sshd start if ssh is ever unmasked with a recorded reason (IMG-06: ssh stays masked)
handled.update_locale: skipped: the r2 locale stays (image-facts.json root.locale; in CI run 42300813861 /etc/default/locale holds only the update-locale header, i.e. no LANG); SR-RX units set the locale they need (Environment=LC_ALL=C.UTF-8); IMG-06 decision (build/15)
handled.enable_service: skipped: `if headless enable_service ssh` would re-enable ssh; ssh.service and ssh.socket stay masked (IMG-06 decision: no SSH in the golden image, build/15)
handled.rebuild_current_overlays: skipped: rsetup overlays are not part of the SR-RX boot chain (STACK.md:138, :843); DT overlays are fdtoverlay output (IMG-05)
handled.remove_packages: replaced: rsetup.service is masked instead; rsetup-config-first-boot stays installed and held

lock_default_password_accounts.source: rsetup config/before.txt creates radxa/radxa and rock/rock at first boot; this image disables first boot and locks any account that already has a usable password hash (IMG-06 decision: no password account; operator access is the local HMI, service access the rescue microSD and the UART5 console)

ppa_list_tokens_from_policy: deployment/receive-only-policy.json apt.forbidden_list_name_tokens (STACK.md:894: PPA lists are removed)

kernel_install.source: STACK.md:843 (entries only from our kernel-install plugin, never rsetup); systemd v255.4 src/kernel-install/kernel-install.c and 90-loaderentry.install.in (layout=other keeps the stock BLS plugin inert)
kernel_install.why_masked: r2 ships 91-u-boot-menu.install (extlinux) and 99-update-overlay.install (rsetup overlay folders on the ESP); neither belongs to the SR-RX boot chain; STACK.md:843 (entries never from rsetup) and STACK.md:138 (never rsetup in the field) (image-facts.json, CI 2026-10-24)

divert_hooks.source: r2 links /etc/kernel/postinst.d/yz-update-overlays and postrm.d/yz-update-overlays to /usr/bin/rsetup (image-facts.json, CI 2026-10-24); STACK.md:138 never rsetup in the field, STACK.md:843 entries never from rsetup. dpkg-divert --local --rename keeps them away across package upgrades; run-parts skips the dotted name

B.source: STACK.md:844; build/07-pz-vstanovlennia.md:165-167; embloader tag 0.4 (https://github.com/BigfootACA/embloader, src/sdboot/file.c, src/loader/loader.c, read 2026-10-24)

enable_common.source: deployment/deploy.py radio_off_unit (WantedBy=sysinit.target); files/srrx-ssh-hostkeys.service (WantedBy=ssh.service: inert while ssh is masked)

not_enabled.srrx.service: IMG-06 decision (acceptance keeps it inert; DEPLOYMENT.md: no .wants links from staging)
not_enabled.srrx-baseband-sweep.timer: enabled at commissioning, after the administrator writes /etc/srrx/baseband.env (system preset: disable; software/RX.md)

dt_overlays.source: STACK.md:843 (fdtoverlay -i <package DTB> -o lab.dtb lab-q6a.dtbo; field.dtb = package DTB + lab-q6a.dtbo + field-q6a.dtbo, pcie0 disabled: field-q6a.dtso header); sources are IMG-05 in deployment/system/dt, CI record dt-manifest.json

data_cache.source: deployment/deploy.py release_guard (verify_cache of the locked base image and kernel debs at /srv/srrx-cache)
